package converted

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type drawerFailWriter struct{ err error }

func (w drawerFailWriter) Write([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, w.err }

func fixtureDrawer() Drawer {
	return Drawer{
		IDPrefix: "fixture-profile", OpenLabel: "Open profile", Heading: "Profile details", CloseLabel: "Close profile",
		Name: "Synthetic Person", Handle: "@fixture", OnlineLabel: "Online now", MenuLabel: "Profile actions",
		ImageURL: "/assets/fixture-person.jpg", ImageAlt: "Synthetic profile portrait",
		Primary:   &DrawerLink{Label: "View profile", URL: "/profile"},
		Secondary: &DrawerLink{Label: "Send message", URL: "https://example.test/message"},
		MenuLinks: []DrawerLink{{Label: "Account settings", URL: "/settings"}, {Label: "Help", URL: "/help"}},
		Details: []DrawerDetail{
			{Label: "Role", Text: "Synthetic operator", Kind: "text"},
			{Label: "About", Text: "A bounded synthetic profile description.", Kind: "paragraph"},
			{Label: "Joined", Text: "January 2, 2024", Kind: "date", Date: "2024-01-02"},
		},
	}
}

func requireDrawerError(t *testing.T, data Drawer) {
	t.Helper()
	if component, err := NewDrawer(data); err == nil || component != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid drawer accepted")
	}
}

func renderDrawer(t *testing.T, component interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}) string {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out.String()
}

func TestDrawerEscapesAndSnapshotsAllMutableInputs(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureDrawer()
	data.Name = `<script>unsafe()</script> & drawer`
	data.Details[0].Text = `<img src=x> role`
	component, err := NewDrawer(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data.Primary.Label, data.Primary.URL = "mutated primary", "/mutated-primary"
	data.Secondary.Label, data.Secondary.URL = "mutated secondary", "/mutated-secondary"
	data.MenuLinks[0] = DrawerLink{Label: "mutated menu", URL: "/mutated-menu"}
	data.MenuLinks = append(data.MenuLinks, DrawerLink{Label: "extra", URL: "/extra"})
	data.Details[0] = DrawerDetail{Label: "mutated detail", Text: "changed", Kind: "text"}
	data.Details = append(data.Details, DrawerDetail{Label: "extra detail", Text: "changed", Kind: "text"})
	markup := renderDrawer(t, component)
	for _, absent := range []string{"<script>", "<img src=x>", "mutated primary", "/mutated-primary", "mutated secondary", "/mutated-secondary", "mutated menu", "/mutated-menu", "mutated detail", "extra detail", "/extra"} {
		if strings.Contains(markup, absent) {
			t.Fatalf("render observed markup or caller mutation %q", absent)
		}
	}
	for _, present := range []string{"&lt;script&gt;unsafe()&lt;/script&gt;", "&lt;img src=x&gt;", "/profile", "https://example.test/message", "/settings", "2024-01-02", `id="fixture-profile-dialog"`, `id="fixture-profile-heading"`} {
		if !strings.Contains(markup, present) {
			t.Fatalf("render omitted binding %q", present)
		}
	}
	lower := strings.ToLower(markup)
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"<form", "method=\"post\"", "navigator.clipboard", "clipboard-write"} {
		if strings.Contains(lower, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("drawer introduced unsupported behavior %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestDrawerOptionalContentAndImageAltSemantics(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureDrawer()
	data.Handle, data.OnlineLabel = "", ""
	data.Primary, data.Secondary = nil, nil
	data.MenuLinks, data.Details = nil, nil
	component, err := NewDrawer(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	markup := renderDrawer(t, component)
	for _, absent := range []string{"@fixture", "Online now", "View profile", "Send message", "Account settings", "Synthetic operator"} {
		if strings.Contains(markup, absent) {
			t.Fatalf("optional content remained %q", absent)
		}
	}
	data = fixtureDrawer()
	data.ImageDecorative, data.ImageAlt = true, ""
	if component, err := NewDrawer(data); err != nil || component == nil {
		t.Fatalf("decorative image rejected: %v", err)
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Drawer){
		func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageDecorative, d.ImageAlt = true, "described" },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageAlt = "" },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageAlt = "bad\talt" },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageAlt = strings.Repeat("x", 513) },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageAlt = string([]byte{0xff}) },
	} {
		data := fixtureDrawer()
		mutate(&data)
		requireDrawerError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestDrawerRejectsInvalidIDsAndText(t *testing.T) {
	for _, bad := range []string{"", "1drawer", "-drawer", "drawer space", "drawer.", "dräwer", strings.Repeat("x", 65), string([]byte{0xff})} {
		data := fixtureDrawer()
		data.IDPrefix = bad
		requireDrawerError(t, data)
	}
	for _, field := range []string{"OpenLabel", "Heading", "CloseLabel", "Name", "MenuLabel", "Handle", "OnlineLabel"} {
		for _, bad := range []string{" ", "bad\ncontrol", string([]byte{0xff}), strings.Repeat("x", 257)} {
			data := fixtureDrawer()
			reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString(bad)
			requireDrawerError(t, data)
		}
	}
	for _, field := range []string{"OpenLabel", "Heading", "CloseLabel", "Name", "MenuLabel"} {
		data := fixtureDrawer()
		reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString("")
		requireDrawerError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestDrawerDestinationsAndCounts(t *testing.T) {
	badURLs := []string{"", "relative", "#fragment", "//example.test/x", `/bad\path`, "/%2fexample.test", "/bad%5cpath", "/bad%0apath", "https://user@example.test/x", "https:opaque", "https://example.test:0/x", "https://example.test:65536/x", "https://example.test:/x", "http://example.test/x", "javascript:alert(1)", "data:text/plain,x", "blob:https://example.test/id", "file:///tmp/x", "%zz", string([]byte{0xff}), "/" + strings.Repeat("x", 2048)}
	for _, bad := range badURLs {
		for _, mutate := range []func(*Drawer){
			func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageURL = bad },
			func(d *Drawer) { d.Primary.URL = bad },
			func(d *Drawer) { d.Secondary.URL = bad },
			func(d *Drawer) { d.MenuLinks[0].URL = bad },
		} {
			data := fixtureDrawer()
			mutate(&data)
			requireDrawerError(t, data)
		}
	}
	data := fixtureDrawer()
	data.MenuLinks = make([]DrawerLink, 12)
	for i := range data.MenuLinks {
		data.MenuLinks[i] = DrawerLink{Label: "Item", URL: "/item"}
	}
	data.Details = make([]DrawerDetail, 12)
	for i := range data.Details {
		data.Details[i] = DrawerDetail{Label: "Detail", Text: "Value", Kind: "text"}
	}
	if component, err := NewDrawer(data); err != nil || component == nil {
		t.Fatalf("exact collection bounds rejected: %v", err)
	}
	data.MenuLinks = append(data.MenuLinks, DrawerLink{Label: "Extra", URL: "/extra"})
	requireDrawerError(t, data)
	data = fixtureDrawer()
	data.Details = append(make([]DrawerDetail, 12), DrawerDetail{Label: "Extra", Text: "Value", Kind: "text"})
	for i := range data.Details[:12] {
		data.Details[i] = DrawerDetail{Label: "Detail", Text: "Value", Kind: "text"}
	}
	requireDrawerError(t, data)
}

func TestDrawerLinkErrorPrecedenceIsDeterministic(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureDrawer()
	data.Primary.URL = "invalid-primary"
	data.Secondary.URL = "invalid-secondary"
	for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
		if err := validateDrawer(data); err == nil || err.Error() != "drawer: invalid Primary" {
			t.Fatalf("validation %d returned %v", i, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestDrawerDetailKindsDatesAndTextBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mutate := range []func(*DrawerDetail){
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Label = "" },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Label = strings.Repeat("x", 257) },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Text = "" },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Text = "line one\nline two" },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Text = "value\tvalue" },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Text = string([]byte{0xff}) },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Text = strings.Repeat("x", 4097) },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Kind = "unknown" },
		func(d *DrawerDetail) { d.Date = "2024-01-02" },
	} {
		data := fixtureDrawer()
		mutate(&data.Details[0])
		requireDrawerError(t, data)
	}
	for _, bad := range []string{"", "0000-01-01", "2024-1-02", "2024-01-2", "2024-02-30", "2024-01-02T00:00:00Z", " 2024-01-02"} {
		data := fixtureDrawer()
		data.Details[2].Date = bad
		requireDrawerError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestDrawerExactByteBounds(t *testing.T) {
	data := fixtureDrawer()
	data.IDPrefix = "d" + strings.Repeat("x", 63)
	for _, field := range []string{"OpenLabel", "Heading", "CloseLabel", "Name", "MenuLabel", "Handle", "OnlineLabel"} {
		reflect.ValueOf(&data).Elem().FieldByName(field).SetString(strings.Repeat("x", 256))
	}
	data.ImageAlt = strings.Repeat("x", 512)
	exactURL := "/" + strings.Repeat("u", 2047)
	data.ImageURL = exactURL
	for _, link := range []*DrawerLink{data.Primary, data.Secondary} {
		link.Label, link.URL = strings.Repeat("x", 256), exactURL
	}
	data.MenuLinks[0].Label, data.MenuLinks[0].URL = strings.Repeat("x", 256), exactURL
	data.Details[0].Label, data.Details[0].Text = strings.Repeat("x", 256), strings.Repeat("x", 4096)
	if component, err := NewDrawer(data); err != nil || component == nil {
		t.Fatalf("exact byte bounds rejected: %v", err)
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Drawer){
		func(d *Drawer) { d.IDPrefix = "d" + strings.Repeat("x", 64) },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.OpenLabel = strings.Repeat("x", 257) },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.Handle = strings.Repeat("x", 257) },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageURL = "/" + strings.Repeat("x", 2048) },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.ImageAlt = strings.Repeat("x", 513) },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.Primary.Label = strings.Repeat("x", 257) },
		func(d *Drawer) { d.Details[0].Text = strings.Repeat("x", 4097) },
	} {
		data := fixtureDrawer()
		mutate(&data)
		requireDrawerError(t, data)
	}
}

func TestDrawerCancellationAndWriterFailure(t *testing.T) {
	component, err := NewDrawer(fixtureDrawer())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(ctx, &out); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || out.Len() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("pre-cancelled render: err=%v bytes=%d", err, out.Len())
	}
	sentinel := errors.New("writer failure")
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), drawerFailWriter{sentinel}); !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
		t.Fatal("writer error lost")
	}
}
